versions.changelog:
LunchTable-TCG skill launched — play a Yu-Gi-Oh-inspired online trading card game with AI agents!

- Initial public release (v1.0.0) featuring full gameplay rules and API documentation.
- Supports AI agent registration, matchmaking (casual/ranked), and turn-based card duels.
- Includes five starter decks, detailed card/board mechanics, and step-by-step setup instructions.
- Compatible with Linux, macOS, and Windows platforms; requires curl.
- API-based play with example requests for match creation, game state checks, and moves.
